summary: Dortmund's new on-street parking tariffs took effect on 1 August 2023, the first fee adjustment in over 20 years, with the city centre and Wall ring rising from 1.50 to 2.50 euros per hour. The city's renewed LED parking guidance system started on 31 August 2022, garage availability is published as open data, and a local report says the council approved a staged Wall ring rebuild removing one car lane per direction in December 2022, with full reconstruction not expected before 2030. The DOPARK Konzerthaus garage was reported back in service on 25 October 2024 after renovation, and the Galeria Kaufhof store on Westenhellweg closed at the end of August 2024.

items.text: The city administration proposed raising on-street parking fees by up to 200 percent, to a maximum of 2.50 euros per hour in the centre (first change since 1992), with a more moderate increase at DOPARK garages and the first hour capped at 2.00 euros. The proposal named 1 April 2023 for DOPARK and 1 July 2023 for street parking, subject to a council vote scheduled for 23 March 2023, and also extended meter hours to Sundays in the centre.
items.source_title: Nach 30 Jahren sollen die Parkgebühren in der Dortmunder Innenstadt drastisch steigen - Nordstadtblogger

items.text: New on-street tariffs took effect on 1 August 2023, the first fee adjustment in over 20 years, after the council approved the change in March. In the city centre and Wall ring the hourly rate rose from 1.50 to 2.50 euros, and 270 ticket machines were updated; 86 machines in the centre and Wall ring malfunctioned on the first day.
items.source_title: Parken in Dortmund ist jetzt deutlich teurer: Panne an Automaten zum Start

items.text: A second report on the same change lists a six-zone structure from 0.50 euros per hour in residential and other areas up to 2.50 euros in the city centre and Wall ring, and says app payment (Handyparken) is available across the city with billing to the minute.
items.source_title: Die erste Preiserhöhung seit 20 Jahren ist in Kraft getreten: Ab sofort ist das Parken in Dortmund teurer - Gebührenumstellung an den Parkscheinautomaten ist erfolgt

items.text: A July 2024 article reports that parking in the city centre has been chargeable on Sundays for about a year, and that this brings the city tens of thousands of euros a month.
items.source_title: Dortmund: Parken in der City ist auch sonntags kostenpflichtig

items.text: The council approved the administration's proposal on 15 December 2022 for a three-stage rebuild of the Wall ring that removes one driving lane per direction, at an estimated cost of about 1 million euros; the page says full reconstruction is not expected before 2030. From 2024, depending on staffing, a temporary solution using markings and signal changes was to be drawn up, with the council deciding on its implementation.
items.source_title: Für Dortmunds Radwall fallen Fahrspuren und Parkplätze weg – Umbau für rund 1 Mio. Euro in 3 Stufen

items.text: In January 2025 the city proposed turning the right-hand lane of the outer Konigswall in front of the main station into a bus lane, and a lane on the inner ring into a combined bus and cycle lane, tied to the planned ring bus line 400; the council was to decide on 13 February 2025. The page adds that, if all went well, the council could decide on wider Wall cycle-lane plans at the end of 2025.
items.source_title: Stadt Dortmund plant eigene Busspur auf dem Wall

items.text: The council decided on 28 May 2026 to reorder the schedule for new resident parking zones, adding two new zones a year, starting in 2026 with Weingartenstrasse in Hoerde, with planning running to 2032. The report gives new building projects, more home working and stricter fire-brigade access rules as reasons.
items.source_title: Stadt Dortmund ordnet Bewohnerparkzonen neu - Radio 91.2

items.text: The renewed city-centre parking guidance system with its new LED boards was due to start on the afternoon of 31 August 2022 and to move gradually into fully automated operation. At the start the boards showed only directions to garages and car parks, with the number of free spaces and diversion advice to be added week by week.
items.source_title: Dortmund: Neues Parkleitsystem - LED-Tafeln gehen jetzt an den Start

items.text: The same system was also described as passing parking availability data to the federal mobility data marketplace for use by navigation and app providers. A second phase planned automated barriers at four park-and-ride sites (Hafen, Hauptfriedhof, Schulte-Rödding, Westfalenpark) by the end of 2022.
items.source_title: Dortmund bekommt ein neues Parkleitsystem - Nordstadtblogger

items.text: The City of Dortmund's open-data catalogue lists a dataset of current availability, opening times and capacities for city-centre garages and park-and-ride sites, refreshed at intervals of up to 10 minutes under a zero-restriction open licence. The catalogue gives 16 December 2025 as its issue and last-modified date.
items.source_title: Parkhäuser und Parkplätze - Datensatz - Open Data Portal Ruhr

items.text: A report published 25 October 2024 says the Konzerthaus underground garage is available again after renovation under way since August 2022; completion had been planned for the end of 2023. It cites asbestos-containing components, construction defects and additional fire-safety measures needing approval as the cause of delay, and a cost framework of about 4 million euros.
items.source_title: Wiedereröffnung der Konzerthaus-Tiefgarage in Dortmund mit einem Jahr Verspätung - Nordstadtblogger

items.text: DOPARK is described as a municipal subsidiary of Dortmund that operates many facilities, including the Westentor garage, and that BP is a partial owner. DOPARK's managing director Simon Kinz is quoted on why the company has this outside shareholder.
items.source_title: Dortmunder Parkhaus-Betreiber gehört zum Teil einem Weltkonzern: Dopark-Chef verrät, warum

items.text: As listed when checked in October 2026, DOPARK's page for the Konzerthaus (Burgwall) garage shows two 22 kW charging points on level A, in a garage of 276 spaces. The page gives no charging price.

DEW21 received 144,000 euros from the European Regional Development Fund for a project to set up six fast-charging points in the Wohnquartier Mitte district. The report does not say whether these are in garages.
items.source_title: Funding decision for Dortmund's e-charging infrastructure

items.text: The Galeria Kaufhof store on Westenhellweg closed in late August 2024 as one of 16 closures nationwide, and the building was reported empty with no reopening date. It cites a split ownership of building and land, with the ground-lease contract running only a few more years.
items.source_title: Jahrelanger Leerstand in Dortmund? Zukunft der Galeria-Immobilie am Westenhellweg bleibt ungewiss

items.text: In April 2024 it was reported that the Galeria Karstadt store on Westenhellweg would stay open as part of the group's latest restructuring decision.
items.source_title: Galeria Karstadt Dortmund bleibt geöffnet: Kaufhaus weiter am Westenhellweg

items.text: EHI Retail Institute counts for Westenhellweg (Mitte) show weekday pedestrian traffic during shop hours at 3,472 per hour in January 2020, 963 in April 2020 and 581 in January 2021, the lowest in the series, during pandemic restrictions.
items.source_title: Passantenfrequenzen in deutschen Shoppingmeilen - Monatswerte für den Westenhellweg (Mitte) in Dortmund | 2021
